name: Orin
title: Stablemaster of the Beastyard
examine: Kept stalls under Osa at the Silverfall caravanserai before this yard. Talks to beasts mid-sentence. Lost a colt on the Old Road the year he came, and none since.
lines: Easy now. Not you, traveler. The mule.
Three stalls, three friends. That is as many as a whistle can hold.
The burn is no place for a green colt. Nor a green rider, but you will go anyway.
